main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 3-bar return over positive-forecast grid bars

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2 (and supporting difference > 0); reject: negative with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 3-bar return, forecast above median of positive forecasts minus forecast 0, inside rising profile

decided_by: The t of the main measure lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The rising profile is the recorded regime 'unknown' (not the chop veto), the coin's mean is over its grid 3-bar returns of all windows, the t pools each day's weighted deviations into one cluster (SE^2 = sum of squared day sums / (sum of weights)^2 x G/(G-1)), the median is over positive-forecast grid bars inside the profile, and a missing supporting group counts as a failed check.
